title: Scripture and Obedience
definition: Scripture and obedience belong together because God's Word is given not only to be heard but to be believed, practiced, and lived.
summary: The faithful hearer of Scripture responds with trust and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus calls His disciples to hear His words and do them, building life on the solid rock of His teaching.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture is not given merely to inform the mind. It is given to lead people into faith, repentance, love, holiness, worship, and obedience. Hearing without obedience is self-deception.

Obedience does not earn salvation. It is the fruit of grace and the evidence of living faith. The Word trains believers to walk in the ways of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people admire the Bible but resist its authority when it confronts their desires. Scripture and obedience matters because discipleship requires doing what the Lord says.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: After reading Scripture, ask what faithful response is required. Confess, believe, forgive, serve, speak, stop, start, or surrender where the Word directs.
